+
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests connections to SQL Server databases.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server using the requested database user and name.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+
+	config := msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+		// Let the caller's context bound the TCP dial and the whole login.
+		DialTimeout: -1,
+	}
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(config, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerDialer{ctx: ctx}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		// A socket deadline can fire just before the context's timer does.
+		var netErr net.Error
+		if _, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok && errors.As(err, &netErr) && netErr.Timeout() {
+			return trace.Wrap(context.DeadlineExceeded)
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer conn.Close()
+	return nil
+}
+
+// sqlServerDialer applies the caller's deadline to the connection so it also
+// covers the driver's login exchange, which can block on socket reads.
+type sqlServerDialer struct{ ctx context.Context }
+
+func (d sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if deadline, ok := d.ctx.Deadline(); ok {
+		if err := conn.SetDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
+			conn.Close()
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+	stop := context.AfterFunc(d.ctx, func() { conn.Close() })
+	return &sqlServerConn{Conn: conn, stop: stop}, nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	stop func() bool
+}
+
+func (c *sqlServerConn) Close() error {
+	c.stop()
+	return c.Conn.Close()
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the server refused the TCP connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) ||
+		(err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused"))
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports SQL Server login failures.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	return errors.As(err, &sqlErr) && sqlErr.Number == 18456
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports missing or inaccessible databases.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	return errors.As(err, &sqlErr) && (sqlErr.Number == 4060 || sqlErr.Number == 911)
+}

+package database
+

+	"context"

+

+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"

+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver"
+)
+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name                    string
+		err                     error
+		refused, user, database bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "refused", err: trace.Wrap(&net.OpError{Err: syscall.ECONNREFUSED}), refused: true},
+		{name: "login failed", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), user: true},
+		{name: "database unavailable", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 4060}), database: true},
+		{name: "database missing", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 911}), database: true},
+		{name: "other SQL error", err: mssql.Error{Number: 102}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.database, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go server.Serve()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, server.Close()) })
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			defer conn.Close()
+			<-time.After(time.Second)
+		}
+	}()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	err = (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port,
+		Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingParams(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, params := range []PingParams{
+		{Port: 1433, DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 1433, Username: "user"},
+		{Port: -1, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 65536, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+	} {
+		err := p.Ping(context.Background(), params)
+		require.Error(t, err, fmt.Sprint(params))
+		require.True(t, trace.IsBadParameter(err))
+	}
+	require.False(t, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(errors.New("login failed")))
+}
